verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs say it tracks requirements, features and bugs "through columns and issues" and manages work through "kanban boards", which covers both parts of the story: kanban boards and columns. The evidence is marketing-level only, with no detail on how boards work and no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of board and column management (creating or customizing columns, moving cards), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the kanban workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plan and track work on kanban boards with columns

citations.quote: Efficiently manage requirements, features, and bugs through issue tasks, labels, and kanban boards.
Gitea tracks project requirements, features, and bugs through columns and issues.
